messages:
Alyssa (Docs): Opening PR to add client-side sharding examples for lyra-embed-8b; found stale link in model card. Can someone review quickly?

Mike (ML): Which link?

Alyssa (Docs): It points to /docs/embeddings/sharding (404) 1; canonical moved to /guides/embeddings/sharding.

Sophia (SDK): Also the SDK snippet uses the old .embed() call. New Node example should use embeddings.create. I'll update the snippet in PR.

Samir (Eng): Heads-up: hosted runtime exposes internal X-Embed-Shard header for testing. Do not document it; recommend client-side hashing instead.

Alyssa (Docs): Good call. Include a short hash-bucket snippet and a note about not using internal headers.

Mike (ML): Add explicit sequence limit note for quantized-8bit: sequence_limit = 8192. Quantized variant best-effort truncates beyond that and embedding quality can degrade.

DocsBot: PR #4123 CI flagged embed smoke tests failing for single inputs >8192 tokens on quantized variant.

Eva (PM): Please add a one-line tradeoff: sharding improves throughput but adds per-shard overhead; prefer batching when low latency is critical.

Sophia (SDK): I'll add: "Tip: batch shards for throughput; keep per-shard payloads under ~400KB to avoid client timeouts" and show Promise.all parallelization.

Samir (Eng): Filed infra-redirects#27 to map /models/lyra -> /catalog/models/lyra-embed-8b. Will deploy a 301.

Alyssa (Docs): Thanks 1. I'll wait for the redirect before merging so external links don't 404.

Samir (Eng): Redirect deployed and tested (301 live).

Alyssa (Docs): CI green after SDK tweak; merged PR #4123. Updated model card with sequence_limit and sharding guidance. Closing. :tada:
